This graph shows Arctic sea ice extent in September, which is when each year’s minimum extent typically occurs. Historical observations are from 1979 through 2024. Modeled projections for four different climate scenarios are from 2015 through 2100. Historical model outputs are shown from 1950 to 2014. Modeled outputs are smoothed using an 11-year moving average. Shaded bands show the range of unsmoothed monthly values from different climate models. Select items in the legend to toggle them on or off.
